subject.title: fix: deliver background task completions through owning sessions

question: Should this PR require live owner-session delivery proof before merge, or may maintainers accept source-level tests and CI for this Telegram-visible session-routing change?
rationale: The code shape is narrow, but the changed behavior is user-visible Telegram message/session delivery and the PR body explicitly says live proof is still pending.

options.title: Require live owner-session proof
options.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.

options.title: Accept source-only delivery risk
options.body: Merge with source and regression-test evidence only, while maintainers own the risk that a real transport/session path still drops or misroutes the completion.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery contract
options.body: Pause this PR if maintainers want one canonical task-completion wake contract across background-task, ACP, exec, and subagent paths before changing the runtime behavior.

recommendation.title: Require live owner-session proof
recommendation.body: Wait for a redacted Telegram Desktop recording, gateway logs, terminal/live output, or linked artifact showing the completion reaches the owning topic/session with heartbeat isolation enabled.
